uploads/science/Scipad/Year 10 Book 2/Wo.searchText: METALLURGY Alloys An alloy is a mixture of two or more elements, one or more of which is a metal. Alloys often have properties that are different to the metals they contain. This makes them more useful than the pure metals alone. For example, alloys are often harder than the metal they contain.
